title: Osis Survival
description: This is an great survival modpack
body:
Osis Survival is a Minecraft vanilla-style survival modpack focused on the classic Minecraft experience — enhanced, not overcomplicated.
Explore, build, and survive in a balanced world that stays true to vanilla gameplay while adding quality-of-life improvements and subtle depth.

The modpack is designed for long-term survival, multiplayer-friendly worlds, and players who enjoy progression, creativity, and exploration without overwhelming mechanics.

Features:

True vanilla survival feeling

Carefully selected quality-of-life enhancements

Balanced progression and performance-friendly mods

Perfect for solo play and multiplayer servers

If you love Minecraft the way it was meant to be played — Osis Survival is for you.
